# README Standard

## Purpose

Apply this skill whenever creating a new repository or modifying functionality that affects the README.

A README should enable a new engineer to understand, build, run, and contribute to the project without requiring additional guidance.

---

## Required Sections

Every repository README should include the following sections where applicable:

- Project Title
- Overview
- Purpose
- Features
- Technology Stack
- Architecture Overview
- Prerequisites
- Getting Started
- Installation
- Configuration
- Running the Application
- Running Tests
- Project Structure
- Deployment
- Troubleshooting
- Contributing
- License

---

## Before Creating a README

Verify the following:

- [ ] The project purpose is clearly understood.
- [ ] The intended audience is identified.
- [ ] Installation and execution steps have been verified.

---

## Before Finishing

Verify the following:

### Project Overview

- [ ] The project purpose is clearly described.
- [ ] The business problem being solved is explained.
- [ ] Key features are listed.

### Getting Started

- [ ] Installation instructions are complete.
- [ ] Prerequisites are documented.
- [ ] Configuration requirements are documented.
- [ ] Environment variables are explained.

### Usage

- [ ] Local development instructions are included.
- [ ] Testing instructions are included.
- [ ] Build instructions are included where applicable.

### Architecture

- [ ] The high-level architecture is described.
- [ ] Major components are explained.
- [ ] External dependencies are identified.

### Maintenance

- [ ] Links are valid.
- [ ] Commands have been verified.
- [ ] Examples remain accurate.
- [ ] Outdated content has been removed.

---

## Common Mistakes

Avoid:

- Missing setup instructions.
- Missing configuration information.
- Outdated examples.
- Broken links.
- Empty template sections.
- Assuming prior knowledge.

---

## Definition of Done

- [ ] README accurately reflects the current project.
- [ ] A new engineer can successfully set up the project.
- [ ] All required sections are complete.
